text:
elaine: FYI customer ACME hit a streaming bug during a billing plan swap — final SSE payload missing, client sees an unterminated JSON object and finish_reason is null. They sent a repro and logs.

elaine: repro steps from customer: 1) start streaming completion (SSE) with token A 2) trigger plan swap that causes a 503 on a reauth call 3) client reconnects using new token B 4) final chunk never arrives, stream ends with keepalive but json incomplete.

elaine: paste of client capture (trimmed):
```
event: message
data: {"delta":"Here is the response...","index":0}

event: message
data: {"delta":"...continuing","index":0}

[connection error 503 during reauth]

event: message
data: {"delta":"final part","index":0}
event: message
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{},"index":0}]}

--connection closed--
```

elaine: note: the client sees an open object/array and their JSON parser throws. finish_reason field is absent. They say curl follow works sometimes but SDK client fails 100% reproducible for them.

raj: @elaine thanks. do we have request_id / trace id?

elaine: gave them logs, they returned request-id: req_0a9f7c3d and span id 4f2b. also attach LiveTrace snippet showing a 503 from auth-service at 2025-11-03T22:00:12Z.

marta: is this the auth handoff that can drop the final flusher? sounds like we might be closing the upstream connection before sending the terminal SSE event after a reauth failure.

olivia: tagging runtime team: @raj @marta - customer impact: blocking. customer asserts it affects ~20% of streamed requests during peak plan-swap window.

raj: quick triage — steps I'll try: reproduce in staging with a simulated 503 from auth, exercise token rotate + reconnect path, capture SSE bytes, check whether we send a final "event: done" or final choices object.

marta: also check prefix/KV cache code path — if cache invalidation happens mid-stream we might be returning a short-circuit response without terminal marker.

elaine: customer also mentioned this started after we rolled billing plan swap code last week. deploy-bot shows a rollout at 2025-11-03T21:58:41Z.

deploy-bot: rollout redwood/billing-swap v2 -> us-west-2 completed (22:01:12 UTC) :rocket:

raj: adding a minimal repro curl for team to run:
```bash
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN_A" \
  -N \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=vicuna-13b" \
  --data-binary @prompt.json
# while stream is open, simulate auth 503 for token refresh on control-plane (in staging)
# then retry with TOKEN_B
```

raj: expected behavior: terminal SSE event with finish_reason and final choices object always sent even if auth fails mid-stream. observed: connection closed with keepalive but no terminal event.

marta: note for logs: look for cut/partial writes in proxy logs (nginx/fastly) then server logs for "stream_end_no_finisher" which we may need to add.

olivia: can we patch a guard so that on auth failure we queue/send terminal fragment before closing?

marta: depends where failure occurs. if auth call fails asynchronously in control plane, worker might unbind and close. quick fix: ensure worker flushes terminal SSE frame (empty delta + choices + finish_reason) on shutdown path.

elaine: customer wants ETA and repro steps so they can validate when patch is up. they'll keep a test harness running.

raj: will reproduce in staging and post trace + raw SSE bytes. if confirmed I'll open a hotfix PR to ensure flusher sends final object on any non-2xx auth outcome.

marta: assigned to me for runtime patch review. I'll try to get a candidate today.

olivia: marking as P1, informing CS.

elaine: thx all. I'll update ACME and paste their full capture once they send it. :thumbsup:
